summary:
{"summary":"plan.md fixes the exact coordinates for all six kit plots. It reads as the Brooklyn Bridge because of two stone-brick towers with sandstone trim, each cut by twin pointed arches (crowns at y48) with recessed rings and hoods; four pale quartz cables over saddles at y57; and diorite-wall suspenders every 3 crossed by fans of 16 (main span) and 12 (side span) stays.\nThe deck has sandstone lattice trusses, grey roads at y27 and a spruce promenade at y30 with dark fences and lanterns, split round the central pier. The granite anchorage has round-arched vaults, the arched approach repeats along z, and lanterns light every walk surface.\nThree brief conflicts are named: the inner cable housings are 2 wide, not 3, to keep the road and promenade clear; plot 5 needs a height cap of y26, not y22, to fit its y23 promenade; and no chain is used (the toolkit rejects it)."} Kit of six modules: twin-Gothic-arch granite tower, deck section, main/side-span cable webs (suspenders plus 16/12 diagonal stays), anchorage, approach viaduct.
Designer sections (palette, vocabulary, parts) added to plan.md; elements.md written.
Dusk lanterns on decks, promenade, parapets.

parts.name: Tower masonry shell
parts.scope: Plot 0 caisson y1..3, base, arch and top stages, arches cut; use coursed_wall, quoin_corner

parts.name: Tower facade and saddle cables
parts.scope: Plot 0 gothic_arch, gothic_panel, cornice_ring, cable_line over the top, lanterns

parts.name: Deck section
parts.scope: Plot 1 truss_bay, roadways, promenade, lamp_post pair z8

parts.name: Anchorage
parts.scope: Plot 4 granite block, round_vault x6, buttresses, cable housings, road and promenade, lamps

parts.name: Approach viaduct
parts.scope: Plot 5 solid masonry, round_vault through x, parapets, deck on top, lamp pair
